parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the GA instance.

parameters.name: AccessLogSwitch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the access log feature is enabled.

You can set the parameter to **on**.

If you leave the parameter empty, all endpoint groups are returned.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group.

parameters.name: ListenerId
parameters.description: The ID of the custom routing listener.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-endpoint-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp14sz7ftcwwjgrdm0000 --access-log-switch on --region cn-hangzhou
